Thanks for signing up to Leaflegal. There are three things to do before you can start buying leads.​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ 
 

Hi Sam,

Thanks for signing up to Leaflegal. There are three things to do before you can start buying leads.

1
Add your regulator and number, then choose the practice areas, matters and regions you want.
2
Choose a monthly plan. Your first month can be £1,000 + VAT.
3
Accept the referral agreement online.

It takes about five minutes.

Continue setup here →

We’ve got your enquiry

Hi Priya,

Thanks for your enquiry. We’re now looking for one regulated law firm that handles this kind of matter in your area. The firm will contact you, usually by phone, to see if they can help. They will explain their fees before you agree to anything.

If you didn’t make this enquiry, or you’d like us to stop, just reply to this email.

The Leaflegal team
